## What changed and why?
Describe the user-visible result and affected components.

## How to run and test
List commands and actual results. Include screenshots for UI/PDF changes.

## Contract impact
State changed fields/tools/routes and which consumers were updated, or "none".

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior and relevant failures.
- [ ] Latest main is integrated.
- [ ] Documentation and synthetic examples are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, real customer data, models or local databases are included.
- [ ] Affected component owners reviewed shared interface changes.
